sources.title: Drag Equation
sources.access: Official equation and reference-area discussion inspected
sources.supports: Drag equals one half density times speed squared times Cd times its reference area. The coefficient and its area convention must be used together.
sources.limit: Does not supply an assembled aerophyte coefficient, biological actuator or efficiency.

sources.title: Drag of a Sphere
sources.access: Official Reynolds similarity and roughness discussion inspected
sources.supports: Sphere drag coefficient depends on Reynolds number, boundary layer and roughness.
sources.limit: Cd0.47 is an imposed sensitivity, not a universal sphere value or a guaranteed conservative bound. Cd0.05 is an unvalidated streamlined alternative with unchanged area ratio only for comparison.

sources.title: High-Altitude, Long-Endurance Airships for Coastal Surveillance
sources.access: Introduction and coupled solar-power/aerodynamic-design discussion, report pp1-2 inspected
sources.supports: Solar collecting area, propulsion, aerodynamics, wind environment, latitude and season require a joint power-system design.
sources.conditions: Engineering assessment of terrestrial high-altitude coastal surveillance airships, not biological flight experiments.
sources.limit: No equipment mass, efficiency, wind climate or biological performance transferred numerically.

sources.title: Autonomous navigation of stratospheric balloons using reinforcement learning
sources.authors: Marc G. Bellemare, Salvatore Candido, Pablo Samuel Castro, Jun Gong, Marlos C. Machado, Subhodeep Moitra, Sameera S. Ponda, Ziyu Wang
sources.access: Publisher-indexed abstract and figure/video descriptions, author-hosted abstract inspected. Publisher full text redirected to inaccessible identity endpoint; author-linked view-only PDF required JavaScript. Full methods not admitted.
sources.conditions: Loon engineered superpressure balloons in Earth's stratosphere; includes a39-day controlled Pacific experiment.
sources.supports: Actual automated balloon navigation used wind information despite uncertainty; publisher description shows use of opposing wind sheets.
sources.limit: Establishes an engineering precedent for wind-aware control, not a lunar wind map, biological controller, zero-energy altitude transfer or universal station keeping.
